text: This is the common course of things, that in seeking to escape cause for fear, men come to give others cause to be afraid by inflicting on them those wrongs from which they strive to relieve themselves; as though the choice lay between injuring and being injured.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
speaker: Titus Livius
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
